WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as client_count 
  FROM client c 
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
  GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(client_count) as total
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.district_id,
    step1.region,
    step1.client_count,
    CAST(step1.client_count AS REAL) / step2.total as ratio
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.total IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  region,
  AVG(client_count) as avg_client_count,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
FROM step3
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
